create_intersection_bound: create an IntersectionBound by passing multiple base bounds to compute the max of lower bounds and min of upper bounds
build_constrained_bound: build a ConstrainedBound wrapping a base bound with additional concrete lower and upper constraints
test_intersection_bound_transform: test the IntersectionBoundTransform to aggregate multiple bound transforms and intersect their propagated bounds
refactor_primitive_transform: refactor the primitive_transform method to propagate bounds across intersected constituent bound types
review_should_handle_as_subgraph: review the should_handle_as_subgraph method to determine if all intersectands can handle a primitive as a subgraph
